snippet.title: Sonic Adventure DX - Director's Commentary (2004)
snippet.description: Sonic Team director Takashi Iizuka reflects on the making of Sonic Adventure (and the improvements to Sonic Adventure DX). Details on the Homing Attack, Light Attack, Gamma, Chaos, Big the Cat, Sonic Team's travels and Tails' Sandboarding. Quite a fascinating interview for those who like that sort of thing. Also, check out Iizuka-san's retro duds. Amazing.
